newsitem.title: CANADA: CanWest Global to appeal television ruling.
newsitem.headline: CanWest Global to appeal television ruling.

text.p: CanWest Global Communications Corp said on Friday that it will petition the federal government to set aside a regulator's decision to reject CanWest's bid for new television broadcast licenses in Alberta.

The Canadian Radio-Television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC) earlier granted the license to Craig Broadcast Systems Inc. "The petition will be filed in the next few days. If it is successful, the CRTC will be required to re-hear CanWest's application," CanWest chief executive I.H. Asper said in a statement.

"Obviously, we are extremely disappointed that the CRTC has decided to award new broadcast licenses in Alberta to Craig, thereby losing the opportunity for a third national television service that would have provided Canadian viewers with more choices and voices, and a greater diversity in programming," said CanWest chief operating officer Jim Sward.
CanWest's application had been fiercely opposed by WIC Western International Communications Ltd of Vancouver, which has four television stations in Alberta.
CanWest mounted an unsuccessful takeover bid for WIC earlier this year.
